chunks: Sa'd, from al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq, from al-Sanadi ibn Muhammad, from Yahya ibn Umar al-Zayyat, from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: All people live off the surplus of the wrong done to us, except that we have made that lawful for our Shi'ah.

key_terms.فِي فَضْلِ: from the excess or surplus of
key_terms.مَظْلِمَتِنَا: the wrong or injustice done to us
key_terms.يَعِيشُونَ: they subsist or derive their livelihood

ai.seo_question: Did the Imams عليهم السلام permit their Shi'ah to benefit from matters connected to their withheld khums rights during the ghaybah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that people generally benefit from what is connected to the usurped rights of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, while the Imams عليهم السلام specifically permitted their Shi'ah regarding that matter. In the chapter context, it relates to the concession concerning khums during the ghaybah.
